activity.notes: Ermesinde recovered and succeeded to the County of Luxembourg in 1197 and governed it until her death on 12 February 1247. The user's 'Duchy of Luxembourg' label is anachronistic for her reign: Luxembourg remained a county until its elevation to a duchy in 1354.

sources.title: Ermesinde de Luxembourg — Connaître la Wallonie
sources.citation_text: The Walloon historical reference records Ermesinde's recovery of Luxembourg and her death on 12 February 1247.
